name: marginalia
description: Share Claude Code's auto memory with your team through git: team notes live in the repo, private notes stay local, with a privacy check and a visible token cost.

teamShare.title: Sharing team notes
teamShare.description: confirm: new or changed team notes wait for /marginalia approve. auto: they are written to .claude/memory/ right away (still uncommitted).

privacyCheck.title: Privacy check
privacyCheck.description: Scan a note for personal data (local paths, e-mail addresses, keys, tokens) before it is shared.

personalStore.title: Personal store
personalStore.description: Git URL of a private repository for your own notes (for example git@github.com:you/claude-memory.git). Empty switches personal sync off.

personalSync.title: Syncing personal notes
personalSync.description: auto: personal notes are committed and pushed to your store after each turn. confirm: they wait for /marginalia approve.
